parse.wikitext:
==Background==
According to [[TzHaar-Ket-Keh]], the Inferno was originally a large incubation pool for newly hatched [[TzHaar]] to regain memories of their ancestors. The TzHaar found out that the deeper they placed the [[egg (TzHaar)|egg]]s, the TzHaar emerging from them would gain more memories and knowledge of their old ancestors. Unfortunately, they went too far and completely drained the lava, finding an ancient incubation chamber. They decided to place eggs from Fight Caves monsters there, but it backfired, creating new, volatile volcanic creatures that were extremely aggressive and fought for dominance. The TzHaar struggle against these new monsters and are hesitant to allow humans to tackle them. Similar to humans, these monsters are foreign to TzHaar, as their names are prefixed with Jal, meaning "foreign" in the TzHaar language.
